mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a monetary tightening with economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases and GDPC1 decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals supply constraints with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
